subject: Nobody can sign in
body: Since about 9 this morning nobody at our company can sign in. After entering the password we get 'service unavailable'. 40 people are blocked and we have a client demo at noon. Please treat this as urgent.

subject: Charged twice in October
body: Hi, we were charged twice for October on our Pro plan: two payments of $199 on the 3rd. Could you refund one of them? No rush, but before the end of the month please.

subject: Schedule a weekly report?
body: Is there a way to have the weekly summary report emailed to my manager automatically? I looked in the settings but could not find it.

subject: Chart total does not match table
body: The total at the bottom of the revenue chart does not match the table underneath: the chart says 12,400 and the table adds up to 13,150. Screenshots attached. It has been like this since last week's update.

subject: Salesforce sync stopped
body: Our Salesforce sync stopped bringing in new opportunities two days ago. The sales reports are now out of date and the quarterly forecast meeting is tomorrow.

subject: Dashboards very slow in Frankfurt
body: Dashboards have been taking over a minute to load for everyone in our Frankfurt office since Monday. The tool is close to unusable for our daily stand-ups.

subject: Card declined, account will be downgraded
body: I can log in fine, but the invoice page says our card was declined and that the account will be downgraded in 24 hours. We updated the card yesterday. Please stop the downgrade.

subject: URGENT: API returns 401 for every call
body: Every API call from our production system has returned 401 since your maintenance last night, even with a freshly generated token. Our customer portal depends on this and is down.

subject: Adding a teammate
body: How do I add a new teammate and give them view-only access? Thanks!

subject: PDF export crashes
body: Exporting to PDF crashes with 'unexpected error' every time for reports with more than 50 rows. We need to send the board pack on Friday. The Excel export still works as a workaround.

subject: Two-factor code is slow
body: The two-factor code by text message takes about ten minutes to arrive, so I often have to request it twice. I can still sign in eventually, it is just annoying.

subject: Scheduled export keeps timing out
body: The scheduled report export has been timing out about once a week. Running it again by hand usually works.
